messages:
Zoe: Planning to lift an SDK-enforced runtime pin for agent-v2 customers so they can hit runtime 3.0.0 in tomorrow's 04:00 UTC window. Posting plan + compatibility notes.

Ken: Which clients are affected? Any forced ABI changes in 3.0.0?

Zoe: No ABI breaks. Main changes: streaming envelope now includes chunk metadata, and runtime adds a backpressure hint that older SDKs ignore (safe). Affected: customers with agent-v2+hard-pins and node-sdk v4.

Ops-Raj: Rollout: soft-unpin with soft-exempt for paid pinsets. Traffic ramp [3,15,60,100]. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx>0.5% 5m or chunk-drop>0.2% 10m.

Yara: We'll scan pinlists and apply soft-exempt to flagged customers. Also preparing a hotpatch for node-sdk v4 to accept new chunk metadata.

DeployBot: Action queued: soft-unpin runtime=3.0.0 window=2026-03-25T04:00:00Z ramps=[3,15,60,100] rollback_triggers=["5xx>0.5%","chunkdrop>0.2%10m"] pin_scan=queued.

Release-Notes-Maria: I'll add a note: "runtime 3.0.0: streaming chunk metadata added; older node-sdk v4 may require shim patch."

Ken: Who owns rollback confirmation? Ops-Raj will get a page; DeployBot auto-rolls then pages SRE.

Zoe: Final preflight at 03:30 UTC. If pin-scan finds customers we will auto-soft-exempt and notify SEs. Tagging thread action:sdk-pinlift-3-0.
